investigation_notes.Visual Observations: Screenshot shows a contact page for 'VITALI Farmacia' with a heart/leaf style graphic and the word 'VITALI' (not 'VITALIS'); page contains a basic contact form and business contact information but no login portal or urgent security prompts.
investigation_notes.Description: The logo scanner flagged a match for 'Vitalis Healthcare' on vitali-pharmacy.it, but the site is an 8-year-old domain hosted behind Cloudflare and returned no malicious IP reputation. Visual review shows a local pharmacy contact page branded 'VITALI' with a contact form and business details rather than a credential-entry or impersonation page, and the text/name differs from the reference 'VITALIS' branding. Given the domain age, benign page content, lack of deceptive elements, and apparent name/logo discrepancy, this appears to be a false positive or unrelated local business use and is therefore Low Priority.
